env.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

x4_config.status: exploratory (dev only, not a registered condition)
x4_config.question: Do the task objects (blocks, small pallets) become findable if Qwen sees an enlarged crop instead of the full 1920x1080 image?
x4_config.image_space: raw (distorted) camera pixels 1920x1080; crop boxes in raw pixels; Qwen bbox_2d is 0-1000 normalised to the enlarged crop; mapped back as raw = crop_origin + crop_px / scale

oracle.what: crop around each ANSWER-KEY small pallet (upper bound: assumes the pallet location is already known)

tiles.what: split the whole image into overlapping tiles, enlarge each, ask every tile (no prior knowledge)

x4_config.invalid_rule: strict: if any crop/tile answer for a query is invalid JSON, the query is invalid (failure). Lenient score (invalid crops dropped) is reported separately.

c1_prompt: Find every instance of "{q}" in this image. Return JSON only, no prose: {{"objects": [{{"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2]}}]}} with integer coordinates normalized to 0-1000 relative to image width and height. If there is no such object, return {{"objects": []}}.
